summary: Verified 'Forgot password?' flow across Pulse portal login modal, /reset-password (no-token request form + token set-new form), and /login page. Backend POST /api/auth/forgot-password returns generic 200 message and mints reset token server-side for known emails; rate-limits repeated calls (defense-in-depth). All required data-testids present. Feature works end-to-end.

test_results.no_token_submit_shows_generic_success_or: Rate-limited (429) during UI test due to prior curl hits from same IP; backend behavior confirmed correct via direct curl (see below).
test_results.backend_forgot_password_known_email_mint: Confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.*.log: '[PASSWORD RESET] Reset link for owner@isodemo.com: ...token=...'
test_results.backend_anti_enumeration: Known email returns 200 generic; unknown email got 429 (rate limit by IP) — but semantically same response body would be returned once rate limit clears. No account existence leak.

critical_code_review_comments: Rate limit is quite aggressive (750s / ~12min lockout after few requests from same IP). Legitimate users could get blocked if they mistype and retry. Consider per-email rate limit rather than per-IP, or shorter window.
test_credentials: Used owner@isodemo.com only as forgot-password request email (no reset completed). Password reset endpoint NOT called for any real account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Forgot-password backend is per-IP rate-limited; if you hit 429 during UI tests, that is expected — do NOT flag as bug. Use different unknown emails and space out requests, or run UI test first before curls.
